sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 400. Success value 100. 2x physical damage (Water).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Removes status ailments.
-Target: all allies excluding yourself. Increases all stats by 50% for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies excluding yourself. Fills Unison gauge by 25.
-Target: yourself. Applies kijin (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies debuffs; nullifies Unison gauge reduction; boosts Ability Power of critical hits by 50; increases attack Ability accuracy by 30%; permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects when attacking) for 60 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Rage for 60 seconds (increases max HP, ATK, and MATK by 100%; nullifies status ailments and Cost reduction. When in effect, recovers 30% of your character's max HP, recovers 30 Cost, and removes debuffs/special debuffs when you defeat an enemy).
Boosts stats of Monsters of all elements by 10% when equipped in the Main Slot.
